newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to meet Chernomyrdin on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to meet Chernomyrdin on Wednesday.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, recovering from pneumonia in an official residence outside Moscow, will meet Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin at around noon (0900 GMT) on Wednesday, a Kremlin spokesman said.

Interfax news agency said the two men would discuss the social and economic situation in Russia as well as problems facing state sector workers and pensioners. Many workers across Russia have not been paid for months.

The meeting with Chernomyrdin will be Yeltsin's first official meeting since he moved to the Gorky-9 residence on Monday. The president, 65, had spent 12 days in hospital after falling ill with pneumonia earlier this month.
Chief Kremlin doctor Sergei Mironov said on Tuesday that Yeltsin was feeling moderately well, although he was tired after working on documents for almost eight hours.
Doctors said there were no medical reasons to suggest that the president, who underwent open heart surgery last year, could not continue running Russia.
